title: Simple autoop
description: A simple server plugin that automatically gives admin permissions to all server players, and you can turn it on and off in the server console. Applies to paper1.12.2
body:
Installation and use

Copy the jar file you downloaded to the plug-in folder of the paper server

How to use:

In the server console, enter autoop on to enable autoOP

In the server console, enter autoop off to disable autoOP

Enter autoop in the server console to see the current status

Player Experience:

Players automatically get OP access when they join a server

Players cannot use any plugin commands

All operations need to be done through the server console

This design ensures maximum security for the plugin, and only server administrators can manage the automatic OP function through the console, while ordinary players cannot control the plugin even if they have OP permissions.
